seedStatements.sql: INSERT INTO universities (id, name, search_name, region, parent_id, official_url, provenance_url, verified_at) VALUES (%(id)s::VARCHAR, %(name)s::VARCHAR, %(search_name)s::VARCHAR, %(region)s::VARCHAR, %(parent_id)s::VARCHAR, %(official_url)s::VARCHAR, %(provenance_url)s::VARCHAR, %(verified_at)s::TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE)
INSERT INTO campaigns (id, university_id, year, level) VALUES (%(id)s::VARCHAR, %(university_id)s::VARCHAR, %(year)s::INTEGER, %(level)s::VARCHAR)

CREATE TEMP TABLE scale_keys ON COMMIT DROP AS
            SELECT md5('program:'||c.id||':'||k) pid, c.id cid, c.university_id uid, c.year, c.level,
                'scale-'||k source_key, md5('public:'||c.id||':'||k) public_id, k
            FROM campaigns c CROSS JOIN generate_series(1,CASE WHEN c.year=2027 AND %(target)s>0 THEN %(target)s ELSE %(per)s END) k
            WHERE c.university_id != 'sgu-saratov'

INSERT INTO campaign_programs(program_id,campaign_id,university_id,level)
            SELECT pid,cid,uid,level FROM scale_keys

INSERT INTO program_catalog_documents(id,campaign_id,source_namespace)
            SELECT md5('doc:'||id),id,'synthetic-scale-v1' FROM campaigns WHERE university_id != 'sgu-saratov'

INSERT INTO program_catalog_revisions
            (id,document_id,campaign_id,original_url,final_url,content_type,document_type,verification_status,
             fetched_at,checked_at,original_sha256,extractor_version,review_sha256,normalized_sha256,
             completeness,program_count,group_count,university_name)
            SELECT md5(d.id||':rev:'||v),d.id,d.campaign_id,'https://synthetic.invalid/scale',
                'https://synthetic.invalid/scale','text/html','synthetic-benchmark','verified',
                %(now)s,%(now)s,repeat(md5(d.id||v),2),'synthetic-scale-v1',repeat(md5(d.id||v),2),
                repeat(md5(d.id||v),2),'partial',CASE WHEN c.year=2027 AND %(target)s>0 THEN %(target)s ELSE %(per)s END,0,u.name
            FROM program_catalog_documents d JOIN campaigns c ON c.id=d.campaign_id
                JOIN universities u ON u.id=c.university_id CROSS JOIN generate_series(0,%(history)s) v

INSERT INTO program_catalog_facts
            (revision_id,program_id,campaign_id,public_id,source_key,title,code,study_form,funding,
             category,seats,evidence,search_text,sort_text)
            SELECT r.id,k.pid,k.cid,k.public_id,k.source_key,
                'Synthetic Программа Straße ΟΣ Ёж 100%%_ '||
                    CASE WHEN k.k=1 THEN 'уникальный ' ELSE '' END||k.source_key||' '||k.cid,
                CASE WHEN %(target)s>0 AND k.level='specialist' THEN '40.05.01'
                    WHEN k.k%%7=0 THEN CASE WHEN %(target)s>0 THEN '38.03.01' ELSE '40.05.01' END ELSE '09.03.04' END,
                CASE WHEN k.k%%3=0 THEN NULL ELSE 'full-time' END,NULL,NULL,NULL,
                json_build_object('synthetic',true),
                'synthetic программа strasse οσ ёж 100%%_ '||
                    CASE WHEN %(target)s>0 AND k.level='specialist' THEN '40.05.01 '
                        WHEN k.k%%7=0 THEN CASE WHEN %(target)s>0 THEN '38.03.01 ' ELSE '40.05.01 ' END ELSE '09.03.04 ' END||
                    CASE WHEN k.k=1 THEN 'уникальный ' ELSE '' END||k.source_key||' '||k.cid||' '||lower(r.university_name),
                'synthetic программа strasse οσ ёж 100%%_ '||
                    CASE WHEN k.k=1 THEN 'уникальный ' ELSE '' END||k.source_key||' '||k.cid
            FROM scale_keys k JOIN program_catalog_revisions r ON r.campaign_id=k.cid

INSERT INTO program_catalog_publications(document_id,revision_id)
            SELECT d.id,md5(d.id||':rev:'||%(history)s) FROM program_catalog_documents d
